svg.text: A little about the person behind the interfaces

text.tspan: I'm Mahmuda Jahan, a Front-End Developer
who enjoys turning ideas and designs into
thoughtful, responsive web experiences.
I care about clean architecture, accessibility,
and interfaces that feel as good as they function.
I build component-driven interfaces that
are responsive, maintainable, and user-focused.
I translate Figma designs into polished React
applications, integrate APIs, manage state,
and create reusable UI systems.
I want to grow beyond simply writing
interfaces into becoming a well-rounded
Product Engineer - connecting design,
frontend architecture, backend systems,
accessibility, and the people using them.
Outside of development, I find inspiration
in painting, gardening, and exploring new
places. I enjoy learning languages and
experimenting with creative ideas — often
bringing that curiosity into what I build.

g.text: Tools for turning ideas into products
Connecting interfaces with data and services
Tools that keep development practical and consistent
